text: Partly because we try to fit much more into a day than previous generations did — work, study, sport, social life and constant messages. Technology saves time on some things, but it also fills every free minute with notifications. I'm not sure we're really busier than our grandparents, who worked very hard physically, but our attention is certainly more divided.

tips.en: Work, study, sport, social life … shows the overload clearly.
tips.kk: Work, study, sport, social life … — жүктемені көрнекі көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Work, study, sport, social life … — наглядно показывает перегрузку.
tips.example: work, study, sport, social life and constant messages

tips.en: Not really busier, but our attention is more divided — a mature conclusion.
tips.kk: Not really busier … but our attention is … more divided — салиқалы қорытынды.
tips.ru: Not really busier … but our attention is … more divided — зрелый вывод.
tips.example: our attention is certainly more divided

text: Often it isn't laziness but fear — of failing, or of a task that seems too big to start. So people do easier things first and feel busy without making progress. Breaking a large task into small steps usually helps. That said, some people genuinely work better under pressure, so a little last-minute energy isn't always negative, as long as the result is good.

tips.en: It isn't laziness but fear goes deeper than the obvious answer.
tips.kk: It isn't laziness but fear — айқыннан тереңірек.
tips.ru: It isn't laziness but fear — глубже очевидного.

tips.ru: Breaking a large task into small steps — простое решение.

text: I think they should, because it's a skill that affects everything else — exams, jobs and even health. Most students are simply told to be organised, but nobody shows them how. Schools could teach basic planning in the first year of secondary school, for example by having students plan a two-week project and then discuss what went wrong.

tips.en: A skill that affects everything else explains why it matters.

tips.ru: A skill that affects everything else — почему это важно.

text: Apps are better for sharing plans and getting reminders, especially if you work in a team. But many people find that writing by hand helps them remember and think more carefully about priorities. Young people mostly use apps, but it's interesting that paper planners have become fashionable again. I'd say the best tool is simply the one you'll actually use every day.

tips.example: Apps are better for sharing plans and getting reminders

text: In some jobs it could work well. Trials in several countries have shown that people can be just as productive in four days if meetings and distractions are reduced, and they're less tired and stressed. But it's much harder for hospitals, shops or transport, which need staff every day. So it might become common in offices, but not everywhere.
